metadata.description: Ragpiq engineering skills — pre-PR audit, brand voice review, and other Ragpiq-specific workflows for AI coding agents

plugins.name: ragpiq-pre-pr-audit
plugins.description: Pre-PR audit skill for Ragpiq frontend work. Runs Bubble field_name validation, n8n env-routing scan, brand voice review, multi-viewport visual audit, then dispatches Anthropic /code-review:code-review on a draft PR before asking for explicit OK to convert to ready.
